bead.title: providers/llamaserver: nest enable_thinking inside chat_template_kwargs envelope
bead.description:
PROBLEM
ADR-010 §7' (2026-05-11 amendment) prescribes that llamaserver's Qwen-family reasoning controls must travel inside the `chat_template_kwargs` envelope, not at the top level. Top-level `enable_thinking` / `thinking_budget` are silently dropped by llama.cpp; only the envelope path activates the chat-template's thinking branch. Until this lands, sindri-llamacpp cannot drive Qwen3 reasoning, which the 2026-05-11 probe-reasoning verification flagged.

ROOT CAUSE
- `internal/provider/llamaserver/llamaserver.go:48-54` pins llamaserver to `openai.ThinkingWireFormatQwen`.
- The Qwen enable branch lives at `internal/provider/openai/openai.go:484-491` and must emit `option.WithJSONSet("chat_template_kwargs", map[string]interface{}{"enable_thinking": true, "thinking_budget": thinkingBudget})`.
- The Qwen disable branch lives at `internal/provider/openai/openai.go:417-432` and must emit `option.WithJSONSet("chat_template_kwargs", map[string]interface{}{"enable_thinking": false})`.

PROPOSED FIX
Confirm the Qwen branch in `internal/provider/openai/openai.go` produces `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking = true/false` (plus `thinking_budget` on enable) rather than top-level keys, then add llamaserver-package-level black-box tests that drive `Chat` through an `httptest` mock and assert the envelope shape on both enable and disable paths. Mock the `/props` endpoint to keep L1 introspection deterministic.

NON-SCOPE
- `ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort` definition / test (separate child).
- Other Qwen-family providers (`vllm`, `omlx`) — their tests are governed by their own adapter beads.
- L1 introspection adapter logic beyond what the test mock requires (covered by existing `introspection_test.go`).
- Per-request `reasoning_format` override (defer; not on the AC-FEAT-003 critical path).
- Reasoning-token telemetry fallback from `message.reasoning_content` (separate child).
- ADR-010 §6' introspection adapter expansion to OpenRouter / Ollama / vLLM / rapid-mlx (fizeau-cdbfcf6d).

Governing artifact: docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-010-reasoning-wire-form-from-catalog.md §7'.
Discovered-from: fizeau-8e37e536 (AR-2026-05-17-repo).
bead.acceptance:
1) AC-EnableEnvelope: `TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_WireBody` in `internal/provider/llamaserver/enable_thinking_wire_test.go` drives `Chat` with `Reasoning: ReasoningTokens(4096)` against an `httptest` mock, asserts the captured request body does NOT contain top-level `enable_thinking` or `thinking_budget`, and asserts `reqBody["chat_template_kwargs"]["enable_thinking"] == true` and `reqBody["chat_template_kwargs"]["thinking_budget"] == 4096`.
2) AC-DisableEnvelope: `TestLlamaserver_EnableThinking_Disabled` in the same file drives `Chat` with `Reasoning: ReasoningOff`, asserts `reqBody["chat_template_kwargs"]["enable_thinking"] == false`, and asserts no top-level `enable_thinking` or `thinking_budget` keys are present.
3) AC-TranslatorBranch: `internal/provider/openai/openai.go` Qwen enable and disable branches emit only the envelope form (verified via captured wire body), with no top-level Qwen keys.
4) AC-GoTest: `go test ./internal/provider/llamaserver/... ./internal/provider/openai/... -count=1` is green.
5) AC-LefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-push` is green.
